'''Barrier Street''' is a location in the [[Rift Dimension]]. It is based on the {{zone|Auction House}}.

== Features ==
'''Barrier Street''' features one main attraction. The player must have secured the {{Item|Globulate Timecharm}} and have a minimum of {{stat|rt|10:00}} remaining in order to access the location.

=== Shen's Auctions ===
{{see also|Shen's Auction}}
Every SkyBlock Year, a new auction will start. Players can bid on items that are being auctioned on Shen's Auction with {{Motes}}. The top bidders on items can claim the items after the auction has ended. Players who did not win can reclaim their {{Motes}}.
